articles.title: Bitcoin researchers propose quantum fix that would not crowd out transactions
articles.snippet: The SHRINCS proposal would let bitcoin transactions use larger, quantum-resistant approvals while preserving more network capacity than existing post-quantum signature designs.

articles.title: StarkWare tests quantum-resistant Bitcoin transaction on mainnet
articles.snippet: StarkWare said the experimental transaction demonstrated quantum-resistant Bitcoin spending without a fork, but it cost up to $200 and required direct miner submission.

articles.title: SHRINCS BIP published: Quantum-secure Bitcoin comes with a catch
articles.snippet: A new Bitcoin Improvement Proposal for the SHRINCS signature scheme has just been published to upgrade Bitcoin to quantum secure. Here’s everything you need to know.

articles.title: Bitcoin Completes First Experimental Quantum-Safe Transaction, Starkware Says
articles.snippet: The transaction used Bitcoin’s existing rules to protect funds from a future quantum attack without requiring a network upgrade.

articles.title: Ethereum Devs Propose Deposit Contract Overhaul to Quantum-Proof Staking
articles.snippet: The proposal would let validator keys grow to 8,192 bytes and adds a switch that permanently retires today's BLS signatures.
